journey.name: Build a flow
journey.description: A mobility flow of your own, built on Train's Mobility pillar from the library's mat moves and holds and a move typed in, or from a copy of a shipped flow ("Make it yours"). It is listed with the shipped flows by when it is for, runs on the workout screen as they do, with its moves named aloud and in the notification, and History names it. Two flows with the same moves and times can't both be kept. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval), with the voice on and the sound up.

actions.action: On "Set up", which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip for now"
Tap the "Train" tab, then "Mobility" in the picker, and scroll to "On your own"
Verify that it holds "Build a flow" with "From the mat exercises and timed holds, or moves of your own"; tap it
Verify that "Build a flow" opens with a name field, "When it is for" on "After, or on a day off", a note field, "No moves yet: add the first." and "Save flow" dimmed
Type "Floor core" as the name, then tap "Add a move"

Verify that the sheet lists "Type a move" under "Your own" and, under "From the library", "Wall sit", "Plank", "Side plank", "Hollow hold" and the mat moves from "The hundred", each with its first line of how it is done
Tap "Plank" and verify that its sheet shows "Plank", "Forearms under the shoulders", "Time" 0:30, "A side at a time" off and "Held still" on; tap "Done"
Tap "Add a move", then "Type a move"; type "Dead bug" and "Low back down, opposite arm and leg out"; tap "+" twice so the time reads 0:40; tap "Done"
Verify that the moves read "Plank 0:30" and "Dead bug 0:40" and "1:30 in all, with the change-overs" (more with a longer get-ready); tap "Save flow"
Verify that the notice says "Flow saved" and that "Floor core" is listed under "After, or on a day off" with "2 moves" and its length
Tap "Floor core", then "Start"; verify "Get ready" with "Plank" and "Move 1 of 2", and that the voice says "Next: Plank"
Turn the screen off for fifteen seconds, turn it on, and verify that the notification names "Plank" or "Dead bug" with "Move 1 of 2" or "Move 2 of 2"
Let it run to the end and verify the summary says "Floor core · Mobility · 2 moves"; tap "Done"
Tap the "History" tab and verify that today lists "Floor core" with "Mobility · 2 moves"
Back on Train's Mobility pillar, tap "Hips and shoulders", then "Make it yours"
Verify that the editor is named "Hips and shoulders (yours)" with its six moves and says "Same moves and times as Hips and shoulders: change a time to keep both.", with "Save flow" dimmed
Tap "90/90 hip switch", tap "+" once, tap "Done", and verify the warning has gone; tap "Save flow" and verify both flows are under "Before training"
Tap "Floor core", then "Edit", then "Delete flow"; verify the notice "Flow deleted" with "Undo" and that "Floor core" has gone; tap "Undo" and verify it is back
